lessons.text: docker compose config -q does not validate depends_on targets or host-port collisions - do not rely on it alone to catch those regressions in compose files

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::makefile fail fast guards e g mobile android mobile ios have no automated exit code assertion in the gate check commands table a silent no op regression would only be caught by manual inspection
lessons.text: Makefile fail-fast guards (e.g. mobile-android/mobile-ios) have no automated exit-code assertion in the Gate Check Commands table - a silent no-op regression would only be caught by manual inspection

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an acceptance criterion says a list must show an entity s details without enumerating fields assert every field the controller actually returns in the test not a subset so the spec precision gap doesn t hide silently
lessons.text: When an acceptance criterion says a list must show an entity's details without enumerating fields, assert every field the controller actually returns in the test, not a subset, so the spec-precision gap doesn't hide silently.
